title: Review of Lifetime CPF Contribution Threshold for Silver Support Scheme
what_it_is: Review of Lifetime CPF Contribution Threshold for Silver Support Scheme

sections.label: CPF and Silver Support thresholds
sections.summary: The passage states increases to CPF contribution thresholds, household income thresholds, quarterly payments, and the number of seniors benefiting.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: In 2021, the total Central Provident Fund (CPF) contribution (TCC) threshold, which reflects the income that seniors earned during their working years, was doubled from $70,000 to $140,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: In 2025, we raised the qualifying monthly per capita household income threshold, from $1,800 to $2,300 – this is about an approximate 28% increase.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We also increased the quarterly payments by 20%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: About 290,000 seniors aged 65 and above currently benefit from the scheme.

sections.label: Fiscal sustainability and elderly support schemes
sections.summary: The passage states that fiscal sustainability and prudence are balanced with top-ups and various support schemes for elderly Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I think this is an important point because we have never, never ever let any difficult spot go unnoticed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I think we need to look and see against the entire fiscal sustainability of what we have as a Government, how can we continue to sustain whatever measures, whatever policies, whatever incentives support schemes that we have given out to all of our Singaporeans, particularly when they are in their golden years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: When we balance fiscal sustainability with fiscal prudence, we also – if I may use a medical word – we also immunise and boost some of the savings along the way through top-ups.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Over the last two to three years of the previous Government, we have introduced the Majulah Package, we have enhanced this Silver Support Scheme, we have also introduced, at various points, the GST Vouchers, Community Development Council Vouchers, cost-of-living vouchers to support and uplift our elderly Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We believe that through a differentiated, a graduated and more targeted series of support, we can better, more adequately and more precisely reach out to each and every one of our elderly Singaporean.
